author: Shengchen Ling, Yajin Zhou, Lei Wu, Cong Wang
claim: Over 280 days Base had 136.7M x402 settlements ($44.1M); 21.20% fictitious, 63.78% internal-cluster; independent nameable catalog revenue floor $187,861.35; 249 catalog payees earned ≥$10; 52.09% of probed hosts still returned a 402.

title: Five Attacks on x402 Agentic Payment Protocol

limitations: Testbed + four production endpoints; not a survey of all facilitators; HTML truncated; authors disclosed to Coinbase via HackerOne.
